messages:
Maya (docs): FYI I opened a docs PR updating the model-catalog entry for fulcrum-lite-quant: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/457 — main items: mark fulcrum-lite-quant as deprecated, add a migration note to fulcrum (recommended alternative), update sequence-limit table, and swap the embed example that accidentally used generate API. :wave:

Ken (ml-infra): Thanks — saw the PR. Quick question: did we re-run the throughput bench with the new quant profile? the old numbers in the card are for quant-v1, which is ~12% slower than quant-v2 on A10g.

Maya (docs): Good catch. The PR includes the older numbers because that was all I had from the original card. Ken, can you paste the updated numbers or should I mark them as "TBD: rebench"?

Ken (ml-infra): I'll run a quick batch tonight and post a summary tomorrow AM. Expect token/sec on 8k context to improve ~+8% with the new kernels. I'll also attach the raw command I used.

Noah (runtime): Heads-up — runtime needs a compatibility note. Fulcrum-lite-quant uses the new fused-attn kernel that requires runtime >= 1.14. If we deprecate the model variant, we should still call out the runtime floor for anyone still using the artifact. Add this blurb: "Requires runtime >=1.14 for fused attention paths; older runtimes will fallback to slower kernels."

Priya (sdk): Also, the embed vs generate example mixup — we should replace the Python SDK snippet with the SDK v3 example. Proposed snippet below (can paste into PR):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
# embeddings: switch from text.generate to client.embeddings.create
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="fulcrum-embed-1", input=["hello world"]) 
print(resp.data[0].embedding[:8])
```

Priya (sdk): And add a migration note: "If you previously used fulcrum-lite-quant for embeddings via generate, migrate to fulcrum-embed-1 or use the embeddings endpoint. Contact support for custom migration help."

Maya (docs): Perfect. I'll drop that snippet in. Priya, can you also add the one-liner for the JS SDK (for the quickstart)?

Priya (sdk): Yep — JS version: `const e = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'fulcrum-embed-1', input: ['hi'] })`. I'll push a small PR to the docs branch with both snippets if that's ok.

Ava (product): Quick commercial note — Dedicated customers still on fulcrum-lite-quant should get a heads-up email before we mark it deprecated in the catalog. Can we add a "deprecation window" line (e.g., deprecated on 2026-05-15, unsupported after 2026-08-15) so SRE/CS can plan outreach?

Maya (docs): Good call. I'll add a deprecation timeline placeholder and tag CS. What language should we use? Passive note or stronger?

Ava (product): Use: "Deprecated: will be removed after 2026-08-15. Contact support to request extended availability." Short and actionable.

Ken (ml-infra): Updated benchmark summary (quick run on A10g, quant-v2 kernels): context 8k, batch 1 -> 310 tokens/s (old card: 288 tokens/s). I'll put the full logs in the PR comments. :bar_chart:

Noah (runtime): Added the runtime requirement sentence to the PR comment. Also flagged that fallback to CPU is possible but will increase latency ~3-5x — worth adding as a note under "limits/compatibility."

Maya (docs): Done: replaced the generate example with the embeddings snippet, added the runtime note from Noah, inserted Ken's bench numbers, and added the deprecation timeline as Ava suggested. Left one TODO for support email copy.

Priya (sdk): CI for docs-snippet-check failed on link lint: one of the internal links to the SDK guide is 404. I'll patch the link in a follow-up commit.

deploy-bot: ci/docs-snippet-check — build failed in step "linkcheck" (code: 1).

Maya (docs): Thanks deploy-bot. Priya, if you can drop the link fix into the same PR I'll re-run. If anyone else sees content regressions please ping. :eyes:

Ken (ml-infra): LGTM on numbers and compatibility text from my side. :thumbsup:

Noah (runtime): LGTM for runtime wording.

Ava (product): LGTM — add CS in the PR reviewers so they can prepare the email.

Priya (sdk): Link fix pushed, re-run CI requested.

deploy-bot: ci/docs-snippet-check — re-run queued by Priya (sdk).

Maya (docs): Thanks all — if CI passes I'll merge this afternoon and tag CS for the deprecation email. If anything else pops up I'll follow up in this thread. :sparkles:
